items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You were probably one of the first drummers besides Krupa to be really featured that much with a band, weren't you? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I would say that, yes.

ctx.x: close the show, so we got the biggest response from that number. Sometimes we'd use "Crescendo on Drums", people would request it. So I'd say "Paradiddle" was the biggest thing, drum.
You were probably one of the first drummers besides Krupa to be really featured that much with a band, weren't you?
Yeah, I would say that, yes. And of course Johnny Morris, you remember that number he did, with Tony Pastor (HUMMING). I forget now, Johnny Morris, I think that was.

items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he was the only drummer then, especially Black drummer, working with all the white groups there in Jersey.

ctx.x: He is from Long Branch or Seabright, if I'm not mistaken, and he was the only drummer then, especially Black drummer, working with all the white groups there in Jersey.
This is before he was with Duke?
